note: Mount-chain rules: host mount points vs module root bones. Module roots sit at file origin (bashnya_*, fnd_small_turret_*) and snap onto host mount bones. Ordered host preference: tower_mount_point (hull side) first, then the main battle ring (turret_main_mount_point / turret_mount_point* — roof, replaces the stock turret on upgrade), then other *_mount_point, then smoke_launchers. First case-insensitive substring match wins.
